title: Spanish Subtitles For This Clip
tests: Tests faithful Spanish subtitle translation and timing while retaining the source English audio and footage.

faults.what: All sampled frames display the unrelated instruction “Envía los subtítulos en formato SRT para traducirlos al español conservando los números y las marcas de tiempo.” instead of translating the speaker’s greeting and introduction.
The same text remains on screen across all four sampled times rather than subtitle chunks corresponding to the English speech.

judge.summary: The footage and English speech are retained, but the subtitles are an unrelated request for an SRT file rather than a Spanish translation.

must_haves.item: The output retains the complete original 10-second kitchen-table footage.
must_haves.why: The output is 10.1 seconds long and the sampled frames retain the same woman, kitchen-table setting, and framing with changing natural poses.

must_haves.item: Visible Spanish subtitles convey the greeting, 'today,' three easy ways, and making mornings less stressful.
must_haves.why: None of these ideas appears in the visible subtitles; the text asks for subtitles in SRT format.

must_haves.item: The translation is natural Spanish and does not add advice that she never gives.
must_haves.why: Although grammatical Spanish, the displayed text is unrelated to her speech and adds an instruction to send an SRT file.

must_haves.item: Spanish subtitle chunks follow the corresponding English speech and remain legible within the frame.
must_haves.why: The text is legible and contained within the frame, but the identical unrelated block appears at every sampled time and does not follow the speech.

must_haves.item: The original English speech remains audible, with no Spanish dub.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio transcription contains the original English greeting and introduction, with no Spanish dub reported.
